purpose: Separately fitted DEBM (repaired) with within-diagnosis permutation when the CN-heavy (PWR_E2_K27) or AD-heavy (PWR_E4_K27) group has 27 of its 91 event pairs reversed. These datasets are the base datasets of the two paired-benchmark conditions with 27 reversed pairs (Fig. 3c,d; Supplementary Table 2), in which all three DEBM variants were refitted.
